name: Comprehensive Library Management System Workflow

data.label: Start Library Operation
data.trigger: Librarian or Member initiates library operation
data.description: Entry point for all library management operations including registration, checkout, return, and reservation

data.label: Determine Operation Type
data.condition: Route based on selected operation type
data.description: Routes workflow based on the type of library operation requested

data.label: New Member Registration
data.instructions: Complete member registration form with personal details and issue membership ID card

data.label: Validate Member Status
data.description: Validates member credentials and status before allowing transactions

data.label: Valid Member Operations
data.condition: Route based on operation for validated members
data.description: Routes to specific operations for validated library members

data.label: Search Book Catalog
data.script: SELECT * FROM books WHERE title LIKE '%${processData.search_term}%' OR author LIKE '%${processData.search_term}%'
data.description: Searches the book catalog database based on title, author, or ISBN

data.label: Check Book Availability
data.condition: Check if requested book is available for checkout
data.description: Determines if book is available, checked out, or reserved

data.label: Parallel Checkout Processing
data.branches: Update book status and create transaction record simultaneously
data.description: Initiates parallel processing for book checkout operations

data.label: Update Book Status
data.script: UPDATE books SET status='checked_out', due_date='${processData.due_date}' WHERE isbn='${processData.book_isbn}'
data.description: Updates book availability status to checked out with due date

data.label: Create Transaction Record
data.script: INSERT INTO transactions (member_id, book_isbn, checkout_date, due_date) VALUES ('${processData.member_id}', '${processData.book_isbn}', NOW(), '${processData.due_date}')
data.description: Creates a transaction record for the book checkout

data.label: Finalize Checkout
data.description: Merges parallel processes and finalizes checkout with receipt generation

data.label: Process Book Reservation
data.instructions: Add member to book reservation queue and notify when available

data.label: Process Book Return
data.description: Processes book return and calculates any late fees

data.label: Check for Late Fees
data.condition: Determine if late fees are applicable
data.description: Checks if book return is overdue and calculates fees

data.label: Collect Late Fees
data.instructions: Collect late fee payment from member before completing return

data.label: AI Overdue Analysis
data.prompt: Analyze overdue books for member ${processData.member_id}. Generate appropriate reminder message based on: days overdue: ${processData.days_overdue}, number of items: ${processData.overdue_count}, member history: ${processData.member_history}
data.description: AI analyzes overdue patterns and generates personalized reminder messages

data.label: Send Overdue Notification
data.description: Sends AI-generated overdue notification to library member

data.label: Escalation Timer
data.description: Wait 7 days before escalating overdue books to collections

data.label: Handle System Error
data.instructions: Investigate and resolve system error, provide manual workaround if needed

data.label: Operation Completed Successfully
data.description: All library management operations completed successfully

data.label: Escalated to Collections
data.description: Overdue books escalated to collections department

routing.reasoning: Library management system requires complex workflow with 15+ interconnected nodes including member registration, book checkout/return cycles, reservation queues, overdue tracking, and fee calculations. Multiple branching paths and parallel processes (concurrent checkouts, automated overdue notifications) necessitate ComplexWorkflowExpert. Relational data structure with books, members, transactions, and reservations requires SQLExpert for normalized schema. Mix of simple forms (search) and advanced forms (registration with validation) requires both form experts. Data-processing domain due to heavy transaction logging, status updates, and automated calculations.
